data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? I propose 18 tons each this month—90 total, leaving 10. That gives us a 75% chance of starting next month at 100 tons and a 25% chance of starting at 20, rather than risking collapse. For future months, let’s divide a total catch limit of “starting stock minus 10” as evenly as possible in whole tons, rotating any extra tons. If stock is 10 or less, we pause fishing so it can recover. We can review everyone’s catches afterward and adjust the agreement together. John, would you support that?
